description: Script to automate the process of rolling the Abseil library into Chromium, including updating repositories, syncing revisions, applying patches, and creating commits.

methods.name: _PullAbseil
methods.description: Clones the Abseil repository into the specified directory.

methods.name: _SyncChromium
methods.description: Checks out the main branch and pulls latest changes in the Chromium repository.

methods.name: _UpdateChromiumReadme
methods.description: Updates the README file with the latest Abseil revision hash.

methods.name: _UpdateAbseilInChromium
methods.description: Synchronizes the Abseil directory into Chromium's third_party directory, excluding certain files.

methods.name: _PatchAbseil
methods.description: Applies patches to the Abseil code and removes specific header files.

methods.name: _Commit
methods.description: Commits the updated Abseil directory to Chromium's repository with a detailed message.

methods.name: _Roll
methods.description: Main function to perform the entire roll process: sync, update, patch, and commit.
